criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief. Required: One incomplete preserved ribbed basal sack fossil-form, rounded compressed elliptical cross-section with an open truncated distal boundary; Palisade of upright tubular ribs around a clearly recessed central cavity, with modest basal sediment infill and basal zigzag seam; No complete whole organism, missing trunk and paired fans not invented; no roots limbs tentacles or feeding claim. Scope: Genus-level original fossil-form study of the incomplete classic Ernietta basal sack, informed by primary2017 Fig3e/f/g actual fossil casts/moulds and Ivantsov2016 description of truncation. Not a living whole-organism reconstruction, facsimile, scan or exact named specimen. The2016 interpretation makes clear the classic sack is a buried basal part of a larger organism with trunk and paired fans; these missing parts are deliberately not reconstructed, before modeling. Central cavity exposed by truncation, some sediment infill, and neutral sandstone palette are illustrative preservation choices. Nominal80x50x55mm targets illustrative, not measured specimen; affinity and original living anatomy uncertain.

concept_decisions: Retain concept hollow truncated sack, tubular relief and basal seam. Correct concept round-vase appearance to a compressed elliptical fossil sack; fewer, finer 30 parallel ribs and an irregular but not ornamental broken rim. Ribs are integral undulations in one closed wall surface, not disconnected pipes. Modest infill is continuous with cavity floor, no coplanar overlay. No high fanlike sculptural walls: short uneven truncated margins, not preserved complete fans. Omit concept photoreal grain. Natural original morphology, not exact replica of a fossil.
